column2: I'm worried about what the $$神官$$s are doing.
Sorry, but I'll go on ahead by myself.
Indeed. The temple is a maze inside.
$$ルピルピ$$, you should go with him.
Ehh? With that smug pretty boy?
What did you say?!
Old man, I'll be fine alone. A woman like her would only slow me down!
Now, now.
And you too, $$ルピルピ$$—don't write this in your $$日記$$!
Does it mean the more they fight, the worse they get along?
What the hell? There isn't anyone here...
The temple's $$封印の間$$ is full of people who wield all sorts of $$神官魔法$$.
We must be careful.
But $$ガイさん$$ and $$ルピルピ$$ still have not caught up with us.
Hmm...
Who cares?!
Even without those two, I'll take them all down myself!
B-but...
Honestly! There are limits to how simpleminded you can be!
$$おにいちゃん$$, $$おにいちゃん$$! Do you think this guy keeps...
bugs in his head?!
Shut up! Less talking, more doing!
Come on! Hyaaaaaaah!
